plain_language_findings: Audited 71237 evaluation trials at dev-calibrated threshold -0.1428.
Detected 8414 False Positives (13.17% spoof miss rate) and 267 False Negatives (3.63% genuine false alarm rate).
Highest vulnerability observed on attack A18 (27.57% EER); lowest on A11 (0.26% EER).
Known attack variants (A16, A19) achieved mean EER 4.97%, compared to 5.51% across unseen generation algorithms (delta: +0.54 pts).
Worst-case false alarms and missed detections logged to worst_case_errors.csv for inspection.
